title: No Language Barrier: Our First Session
deck: Soul & Script opened with a simple challenge — cross your boundaries. Here's how our first session, held in Lecture Theatre 3, went.
author: Soul & Script Media Team
body: On 18th May, at 1:30 PM in Lecture Theatre 3, Soul & Script held its first-ever session: No Language Barrier. Cross your boundaries.

The idea was simple — creativity doesn't need a single shared language to be understood. Readers, writers, thinkers, painters, and artists came together to share pieces in whatever language and form felt most honest to them, and the room met every one of them the same way.

It set the tone for everything since. This is a space for every art, every voice, and every boundary worth crossing — and it's just getting started. If you weren't there, the next session is coming — check the Events page, or join our WhatsApp group to hear first.
